items.Sentence: WDRs Order 86-032 allows a 30-day dry weather discharge of up 28,000 gpd to be discharged to four unlined effluent retention ponds.
Domestic wastewater from the Villa Las Paz Conference Center gravity flows to a 2,000-gallon concrete vault at Pump 1 (referred to as “Pond 1 Pump Station in Attachment B”).
When the vault is full, the pump turns on and discharges primary treated wastewater to Pond 1 via a 6-inch pipeline.
